notes.title: Xochi's Apothecary at the Gayming Live Indie Festival
notes.notes:
Greetings alchemists,

Xochi's Apothecary has been selected to participate in the Gayming Live Indie Festival! We'll be appearing alongside other LGBTQ+ indies in a Steam event from September 30th to October 14th. As part of the festival, we'll be broadcasting the second sneak peek of the Xochi's Apothecary demo - make sure to check it out!

Happy brewing,
The Single Effect team

notes.title: Xochi's Apothecary at Game Devs of Color Expo
notes.notes:
Greetings alchemists,

We are excited to announce that Xochi's Apothecary has been selected to participate in the Game Devs of Color Expo, here on Steam. As part of the festival, we will be broadcasting a per-recorded sneak peek of the Xochi's Apothecary demo!

The event begins today, September 20, and will run through September 29.

Happy brewing!
The Single Effect team
